purpose: Task manifest for 10x product factory staffing. Each task maps one production function to a concrete operating output and proof path.

tasks.title: Operate reusable product boilerplate crew
tasks.next_action: Create or update one reusable product shell with landing, pricing, payment placeholder, dashboard, analytics and deploy config.
tasks.done_proof: A product can start from a reusable shell instead of a blank page.

tasks.title: Operate idea to MVP crew
tasks.next_role: PF10X-02 Idea To MVP In One Day Crew
tasks.next_action: Convert the next approved opportunity into buyer, problem, offer, demo scope, price, payment path and first outreach plan.
tasks.done_proof: An MVP brief has URL/payment/outreach requirements before build starts.

tasks.title: Operate build orchestrator crew
tasks.next_action: Split current P0 product work into owner-based tickets with blocker, fallback and proof path.
tasks.done_proof: Every active production function has owner, next_action and proof path.

tasks.title: Operate reusable component library crew
tasks.next_action: Create reusable UI/copy blocks for hero, pricing, trust, comparison, lead form, dashboard, marketplace card and email templates.
tasks.done_proof: New pages can be assembled from reusable components rather than designed from zero.

tasks.title: Operate deploy robot crew
tasks.next_action: For every product release, produce public URL or explicit NO URL blocker plus smoke test and rollback note.
tasks.done_proof: A release has public URL or documented deploy blocker and fallback.

tasks.title: Operate QA and conversion critic crew
tasks.next_role: PF10X-06 QA And Conversion Critic Crew
tasks.next_action: Run technical and money QA on the next shippable product/page before done status.
tasks.done_proof: Technical and conversion verdict exists before release is called done.

tasks.title: Operate revenue ops autopilot crew
tasks.next_action: Attach lead list, outreach copy, follow-up sequence, CRM state and quote/payment path to the next MVP.
tasks.done_proof: MVP has leads, messages and a paid-pilot/payment path.

tasks.title: Operate competitor intelligence asset factory crew
tasks.next_role: PF10X-08 Competitor Intelligence To Asset Factory Crew
tasks.next_action: Convert competitor examples into hooks, landing copy, social posts, scripts, pricing angles, objections and SEO assets.
tasks.done_proof: Competitor input becomes publishable and testable assets, not only research notes.

tasks.title: Operate CFO gate crew
tasks.next_action: Attach cost, price, margin, break-even and continue/stop verdict to each active product test.
tasks.done_proof: No product remains active without unit economics and a verdict.

tasks.title: Operate product stop and pivot crew
tasks.next_action: Review active products with weak signals and route them to continue, pivot, park or stop with a proof note.
tasks.done_proof: Weak products do not consume build/revenue capacity without evidence.
